question: Does the closed-form Jacobi-elliptic omega(t) match DOP853 and conserve 2T/L^2 across the full post-fix m048 cohort, and how fast is it?
hypothesis: Closed-form omega_jacobi reproduces DOP853 to rtol < 1e-8 with exact conservation and a large speedup.
narrative_md: Closed-form omega_jacobi validated on all 120 post-fix m048 trajectories: worst omega rel err 1.8e-10 vs DOP853 (median 2.7e-11), 2T and L^2 conserved to ~1e-14, 160x faster than DOP853 (0.18 ms/seed). Regime split 104 Case A / 16 Case B. The q-gate 'failure' (7e-8) is pure DOP853-vs-DOP853 integration noise, not Jacobi error -- hybrid q (Path 3) exactly tracks fresh DOP853. Full closed-form q(t) deferred to s062b. Validates against cached cohort truth trajectories (render-at-truth).
